subject: Update "Total" message and used_memory_human log information in serverCron() function (#594)
reason: The change only edits the text of a periodic LL_DEBUG log line in serverCron() (adding a human-readable form of zmalloc_used_memory() via the existing bytesToHuman helper, whose prototype is added to server.h). It alters no command replies, no replication, persistence, or cluster behaviour, and no data structures — it is a cosmetic logging change with no externally observable behaviour for the fuzzer's oracles or a compared command sequence to detect, so no scenario is needed.
